u_ren1.c_gk_cq01h.why: Rename 1's head read of the pending group (#35): a later group's lanes read the earlier group's pending-writer masks, registered at 03, two cycles on; no path from the reader's outputs closes back into the cone (OA 513 (2), OA 515). pw_seen checks every pending writer is seen; pw-drop drops the pending valid.

u_ren1nr.pn_gname_cq01h.why: Rename 2's pending names (m_gname_cq04h), a register read back three cycles on through a port with no closing path (OA 514, OA 515). pn_bound (pw_seen's Rename 2 half) holds that a read with a pending writer finds Rename 2's register holding the group just ahead of its own, and that the port it names writes the class it reads; pn-late (Rename 2's register skips every other group) breaks it.

u_ren1nr.pn_pname_cq01h.why: Rename 2's pending names (m_pname_cq04h), a register read back three cycles on through a port with no closing path (OA 514, OA 515). pn_bound (pw_seen's Rename 2 half) holds that a read with a pending writer finds Rename 2's register holding the group just ahead of its own, and that the port it names writes the class it reads; pn-late (Rename 2's register skips every other group) breaks it.

u_select.gnt_cq03h.why: select's mask of last cycle's grants (OA 509 (3a)): the grant register gnt_cq04h, read back at 03 a cycle on, keeps an entry granted then from being granted again before its issued bit lands. A missing mask regrants (no_regrant; control regrant).

u_select.hold_cq03h.why: the ret hold (OA rev 293, OA 509 (3a)): a ret granted last cycle (gnt_cq04h over rtq_cq04h) holds this cycle's branch and call grants. ret_holds (OA 510): no branch or call is granted the cycle after a ret's grant; control no-hold removes select's ret hold under CCV_CHECK_SCHED.

u_select.rhold_cq03h.why: RA-17's idle-R force, closed through the grant register (OA 512, OI-230): u_select's grant at 03 is held in gnt_cq04h; R granted last cycle (gnt over rrq) extends the run rnx, and the force copies fcp_cq04h take it with the migration a cycle ahead; select reads fcp as rhold at 03 and holds R's footprints off. A force that comes a cycle late lets an idle R run past idle_r_k (idle_r; control no-force).

sv_cq02h.why: ooe_decrx's per-warp slot table (OA 509 (3c), Option A): the parent's cq02h registers, written at a release or an allocation for the next cycle (advances bypassed through adv/adn), read by u_keep's enqueue compare at 01; no uop of a warp released or allocated in a cycle arrives in it (keep_row_settled; control row-early).
